NNB RECORDS Presents
GAR NARI GAWARI | Niazi Nizami Brothers | Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya (R.A.)
Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem
With love, devotion, and deep spiritual feelings, Niazi Nizami Brothers proudly present our special new release — “Gar Nari Gawari.”
This beautiful kalam is our humble Nazrana-e-Aqeedat (a devotional offering of love and respect) at the blessed shrine of Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya (R.A.).
Through this soulful presentation, we have tried to express our love for the beloved saint, the timeless Sufi spirit, and the spiritual atmosphere of his blessed Darbar.
